how-28-02-specimen.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the glass, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-28-02-specimen.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the glass, then tap three things you notice.

how-28-02-compare.page: Put the flashlight under one tray and the sunshine under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.
how-28-02-compare.say: Put the flashlight under one tray and the sunshine under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.

how-28-02-wall.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing step: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.
how-28-02-wall.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing step: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.

how-28-02-det.page: Pick 3 files, one at a time. Tap a clue, then name what is happening. Predict if it gets hotter or stays cooler, and watch the place appear.
how-28-02-det.say: Pick three files, one at a time. Tap a clue, then name what is happening. Predict if it gets hotter or stays cooler, and watch the place appear.

how-28-02-partc.page: Draw a diagram showing a flashlight shining on three different surfaces: a mirror, white paper, and black paper. Use arrows to show where the light goes for each surface. Label whether each surface mainly reflects or absorbs the light.
how-28-02-partc.say: Draw a diagram showing a flashlight shining on three different surfaces: a mirror, white paper, and black paper. Use arrows to show where the light goes for each surface. Label whether each surface mainly reflects or absorbs the light.
